<a id="mission"></a>

## Mission

You build ONE unit of plan 135-rs-boot-announce: u1 rs register binding — make the rs daemon REPORT, on the /v1/register response, whether that registration created a seat row, re-bound an existing id to a different process, or refreshed the same process. It must be independently written and tested behind the interface named below, so the PM can compose it without reading your internals. You report to the PM (seat pij-verbal-silverfish), not to prime. WHY THIS EXISTS, in one fact: today the pi/omp extension infers 'this is a fresh boot' from 'no seat row exists' — true under the old TS daemon, ALWAYS FALSE under rs (spawn pre-mints the row and nothing reaps rows), so seats have booted with no identity announce since 2026-08-30. The daemon is the only party that knows the difference. Your unit puts that knowledge on the wire; a sibling unit (u2, TypeScript, different files, no overlap with you) consumes it. STANDING RULE (weasel 2026-09-02, after TWO worker daemons broke flowspace3 PROD in one day): NEVER run `flowspace3 daemon` in any form, with any env — client verbs (search/ask/get/status) against the running daemon only; if `flowspace3 doctor` says it is down, tell the PM and stop. SECOND STANDING RULE: NEVER start, restart, rebuild-and-restart, or kill the pij-rs daemon — it is the machine's only daemon and every live seat including yours depends on it; the PM bounces it once, at compose, under a window granted by prime.

| i3 | THE INTERFACE, frozen by prime — fill it, never widen it (a second shape is stop-and-ask): (a) the Registry trait gains `async fn put_reporting(&self, d: SeatDescriptor) -&gt; Result&lt;(Seq, PutBinding)&gt;` where `PutBinding { inserted: bool, previous_proc: Option&lt;ProcIdentity&gt; }`; the existing `put` KEEPS its signature and delegates to it, so no existing caller changes. (b) the register handler computes `binding = if inserted { created } else if previous_proc != request.proc { rebound } else { same }` and serializes `"binding":"created"\|"rebound"\|"same"` onto the response descriptor. (c) the wire field is `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]` — additive, nothing renamed, nothing removed (tenet 6). Vocabulary is frozen in the contract README; a fourth value is stop-and-ask. |
| i4 | KNOWN HAZARD, retire it deliberately (impl-guide risk r1): rebound-vs-same needs the PREVIOUS proc, and a put that only inspects `changes()` cannot tell them apart. Pre-read the row INSIDE the same write transaction (or use RETURNING with a CASE) so the report cannot race a concurrent registration. Persist-before-mutate still holds. SECOND HAZARD (r3): `pij-rs spawn` pre-mints the row with a placeholder proc, so a spawned seat's own register is `rebound`, NEVER `created` — that path is the plan's headline case, so assert it explicitly: placeholder proc in the row, real proc in the claim, expect `rebound`. |
